sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption examined local government responses to its public integrity survey.
sentences.support: This report focuses on the views of public officer workings in the local government.

sentences.text: The voluntary survey received 1114 responses from local government public officers and asked about perceived risks, experiences and reporting.
sentences.support: It received 1114 responses from public officers within the local government sector.

sentences.text: The Commission reported lower perceived corruption than in its earlier survey, with recruitment favouritism still seen as the leading risk.
sentences.support: The perceptions of levels of corruption had also decreased since the Commission’s first Public Integrity Survey conducted in 2018.

sentences.text: The Commission recommended further training, clearer employment decisions, controls on outside employment, scrutiny of contracts and protection for people reporting concerns.
sentences.support: It is recommended that local councils ensure that they develop and implement policies relating to secondary employment.

findings.quote: All public officers should feel safe to report.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. Recommendations are unnumbered. The survey methods section dates fieldwork to November–December 2021, while the foreword says October; no fieldwork month is asserted in the summary. Results are perceptions and may not represent all local government public officers.
